name: KeyBelt
notes: Public beta: the whole toolset is now labelled beta. The Settings window title, version label and Updates card show "beta".
Motion Trail is no longer flagged beta. It is built on the Agora Community motion trail, used as the base, then modified and improved for KeyBelt.
Motion Trail moved from Secondary motion to the Baking / curve tools group (yellow) in the timeline toolbar and the docs.
Settings > General > Updates: new Send feedback button, opens the feedback page in your browser with your KeyBelt and Maya versions filled in.

Automatic updates: KeyBelt downloads and verifies new versions in the background and installs them the next time Maya starts, with a short "Updated to x.y.z" message. On by default (Settings > General > Updates > Update KeyBelt automatically). By hand, one button goes Check for updates → Update to x.y.z → Restart Maya to finish.

Documentation restyled to match the KeyBelt website (dark / light theme, Inter font bundled for offline use, tool icons in the sidebar) and extended with a mission note and a Working with KeyBelt windows section (MMB drag to move, RMB drag to resize).
